23	/**
24	 * Builds an owner's {@code customerCode}, formatted {@code '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'} where LAST3 is the
25	 * upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded
26	 * sequence equal to one more than the current number of owners (e.g. {@code 'SMI-0007'}).
27	 */
28	@Component
29	public class CustomerCodeGenerator {
30	
31	    /**
32	     * @param lastName   the owner's last name, used for the LAST3 prefix
33	     * @param ownerCount the current number of stored owners; the sequence is one greater
34	     * @return the formatted customer code
35	     */
36	    public String generate(String lastName, long ownerCount) {
37	        int length = Math.min(3, lastName.length());
38	        String prefix = lastName.substring(0, length).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
39	        return String.format("%s-%04d", prefix, ownerCount + 1);

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

      required:
        - message

          example: 1

          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name

## Summary

I implemented the `membershipNumber` assignment formatted `<customerCode>-M<YY>`, where `YY` is the last two digits of the `registrationDate` year (e.g. `SMI-0007-M26`).

Since the value is derived purely from the owner's own `customerCode` and `registrationDate` (no external state), I followed the codebase's established idiom for derived read-only fields — the computed getters `getDisplayName()` / `getInitials()` on `Person`, which MapStruct projects into the DTO — rather than the assigned-at-creation pattern used for `customerCode` (which depends on the mutable owner count and is stored as a column).

Two focused changes:

1. **`Owner.java`** — added a computed `getMembershipNumber()` getter that formats the two existing fields, guarding against nulls (legacy/seed owners lack a customer code and registration date) so it never NPEs on read. `%02d` correctly zero-pads years like 2007 → `07`.

2. **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `membershipNumber` property to the `Owner` response schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field and MapStruct auto-maps `getMembershipNumber()` into it — no mapper or controller changes needed.

Note `registrationDate` is only defaulted at `@PrePersist`, so computing on read (rather than assigning in the controller before save) is what keeps the value correct — reinforcing the getter approach over an eager assignment.

The new `AcceptanceTest.coreMembershipNumberFormat` passes and the full suite builds green.
